newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Tight supply lifts prices.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Tight supply lifts prices.

text.p: Millfeed prices were mostly steady to higher Thursday with dealers attributing the support to reduced flour production.
Chattanooga sources reported good demand from the hog and dairy industries supported prices, but elsewhere tight supplies supported prices.
Several dealers said flour mills are operating five days or less a week, which has kept millfeed supplies tight.
"They are having trouble selling the flour," said a Carolina source.
A Buffalo source said flour sales are seasonally slow now, which prompted a cutback in production. He said one local flour mill ran three days this week, down from a normal five or six days.

Lower prices for deferred millfeeds, such as April-June and July-September, has prompted an increased amount of inquiries from feedmixers, but so far trades have been light for those positions, they said..
